⛔ Lancashire's council shake-up is on hold — because Whitehall isn't sure it was legal.

On Monday 7 September, Angela Rayner told the Commons that local government reorganisation is being paused for a full review. Decisions already taken in four areas were withdrawn. Work in 14 more was halted. The reason: legal advice, and wanting to be sure the process "complies with the law".

📜 Lancashire's councils submitted FIVE competing proposals back in November 2025. Shadow elections were set for May 2027. New unitary councils were due in April 2028.

⏸️ All of it now sits behind a legal review with no end date — while the 2028 deadline stays exactly where it was. You know what that means: they'll make up the time by cutting short the bit where the public gets a say.

🔧 My view? This was never about better bins or better roads. It was about drawing maps that make mayors possible. Structures first, services second — and that's the wrong way round.

Reform UK runs Lancashire County Council. We'll carry on doing the job while they check their homework.
